text:
CHINESE WUSHU MONK 🐉

Created this using GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 on @mirrorizeai

Prompt & Workflow↓ https://t.co/Ca540coKFX
content: Generate a multi-view character design sheet (front/side/back) in GPT Image 2 with detailed wardrobe, accessories, weapon, color palette, and a clean white concept-art layout, then use that image as the visual source for Seedance 2.0 to animate the character.

thread_texts:
GPT IMAGE 2 PROMPT:-

A highly detailed realistic character design sheet for "LONG" a Shaolin Wushu warrior monk. Front, side, and back view. Age 28, perfectly toned lean muscular build. Wearing saffron and white Shaolin monk robes, partially open revealing toned chest with tiger tattoo. Weapon: dragon-carved wooden staff. Accessories: prayer beads on wrist, shaved head with meditation scar markings. Color palette: saffron orange, warm white, black, golden brown. Character stats panel. Clean concept art layout on white background. Realistic 3D render style.
